author: Inside Edition
description: Friends of Carolyn Bessette-Kennedy are standing up for her Tuesday after an article on Daily Mail said "the real Carolyn Bessette was a violent, deeply disturbed coke head." It was written by Maureen Callahan, who wrote a bestseller about the Kennedys and is host of "The Nerve" podcast. The article comes on the heels of the hit TV series "Love Story." Bessette's friends Theresa Demaria and Guy Clark spoke with Inside Edition.
title: Friends Of Carolyn Bessette Speak Out After Explosive Article

author: Inside Edition
description: Rihanna is fleeing Los Angeles after the shooting at her Beverly Hills mansion. The singer's staff loaded up her belongings and her convoy headed to an airport where Rihanna was spotted on a private jet taking off. Rihanna is "freaking out," a source close to her told "People Magazine." Police booked Ivanna Ortiz for attempted murder after they say she drove up to Rihanna's home on Sunday afternoon and opened fire with an assault rifle.
title: Rihanna Leaves Los Angeles Following Shooting At Her Home

author: Inside Edition
description: Three reporters are being credited with helping to bring down three top real estate brothers who may now spend the rest of their lives behind bars. The millionaire Alexander brothers were just found guilty of sex crimes. Prosecutors say they raped 60 women, many of them in the real estate business who were drugged and video-taped without their consent or knowledge. Reporters for "The Real Deal" were the first to expose the Alexander brothers.
title: 3 Reporters First To Expose Alexander Brothers Of Sex Crimes

author: Inside Edition
description: Luckily no one was in this house when a fire spread and led to a collapse of the interior. The Egg Harbor Township Police Department says it responded to calls of smoke coming from a house in New Jersey. After failing to make contact with any homeowners, they forced entry. They say the only occupant of the house was the family dog. A neighbor came in to get the scared pup, who seemed to be avoiding the police officers. Inside Edition Digital’s Mara Montalbano has more.
title: Dog Rescued From House Fire Moments Before Collapse

author: Inside Edition
description: Authorities are identifying the alleged shooter as Ivanna Ortiz of Orlando, Florida. She has a history of misdemeanor arrests.
title: Cops Say Florida Woman Shot At Rihanna's Home With Assault Rifle #shorts
